title: I Capture the Castle
author: Dodie Smith
summary: Seventeen-year-old Cassandra records family life in a crumbling English castle in the 1930s. Her writer father is blocked and the household is poor, until two wealthy American brothers arrive.
readIf: you love charming, witty diary-style novels with a distinct narrator and a touch of romance.
skipIf: you want a fast plot or a modern setting.
